summary: Selects and loads geometry primitives from USD COMP or FBX COMP imports directly into POP GPU memory. Unsupported geometry types are converted into POP triangles, quads, line strips, or point primitives, with optional playback controls.

key_params.name: geometry
key_params.note: Geometry path in the imported file

key_params.note: Shift imported animation to its start time

key_params.name: sampleratemode
key_params.note: Use file FPS or custom sample rate

key_concepts: Import Select POP loads geometry primitives from USD COMP or FBX COMP imports directly into POP GPU memory.
The parent COMP and geometry path define the import source; when no parent is specified, TouchDesigner searches for an import parent in the path.
Unsupported source geometry types are converted into POP-compatible triangles, quads, line strips, and point primitives.
Merged imported geometry can create an Info DAT next to the POP to preserve original primitive path provenance.
Playback can use the parent import animation or the POP's own playback controls, including sample-rate mode, specified index, cueing, trimming, and extension behavior.
common_gotchas: Import Select POP depends on a valid USD or FBX parent COMP; without one it cannot locate geometry paths.
Merged geometry can create an Info DAT with original primitive paths; preserve that when path provenance matters.
Geometry is loaded directly to GPU memory, so large assets need memory-aware planning before downstream duplication.
